questions.question: The value of i² is which of the following?
questions.explanation: By definition i = √(-1), so i² = -1.

questions.question: In a + bi, which variable represents the real part?
questions.explanation: In standard form a + bi, a is the real part and b is the imaginary part.

questions.question: A complex number with a real part of zero is called which of the following?
questions.explanation: When the real part is zero, the complex number is purely imaginary.

questions.question: The conjugate of the complex number a + bi is which of the following?
questions.explanation: The conjugate changes the sign of the imaginary part.

questions.question: Which of the following is the conjugate of 5 - 3i?
questions.explanation: The conjugate of 5 - 3i is 5 + 3i.

questions.question: The complex number 7i is classified as which of the following?
questions.explanation: Since the real part is zero, 7i is purely imaginary.

questions.question: Which of the following is a real number?
questions.explanation: A complex number with zero imaginary part is a real number.

questions.question: The standard form of a complex number is which of the following?
questions.explanation: The standard form is written as a + bi, where a and b are real.

questions.question: The imaginary part of the complex number 4 + 7i is which of the following?
questions.explanation: In a + bi, b is the imaginary part, so here it is 7.

questions.question: Which of the following represents the conjugate of 12 - i/2?
questions.explanation: The conjugate changes the sign of the imaginary part, giving 12 + i/2.

questions.question: The square root of -9 can be written as which of the following?
questions.explanation: The principal square root is √(-9) = √9√(-1) = 3i.

questions.question: When the imaginary part of a complex number is zero, the number is which of the following?
questions.explanation: If b = 0 in a + bi, the number is a real number.

questions.question: The conjugate of a real number is which of the following?
questions.explanation: The conjugate of a real number a is a, since there is no imaginary part to change sign.

questions.question: The complex number 0 + 0i is classified as which of the following?
questions.explanation: Since the imaginary part is zero, it is a real number, specifically zero.

questions.question: The expression √(-100) simplifies to which of the following?
The conjugate of 9 + 15i is which of the following?
questions.explanation: The conjugate changes the sign of the imaginary part, giving 9 - 15i.

questions.question: Which of the following is the conjugate of -20i + 19?
questions.explanation: Rewrite as 19 - 20i; the conjugate is 19 + 20i, which is 20i + 19.

questions.question: The expression √(-5) simplifies to which of the following?
To add two complex numbers, you add which parts separately?
options: Real parts and multiply imaginary parts
questions.explanation: Addition involves adding the real parts together and the imaginary parts together.

questions.question: The sum of -4 + 7i and 5 - 10i is which of the following?
questions.explanation: Add real parts: -4 + 5 = 1; add imaginary parts: 7i - 10i = -3i.

questions.question: The result of 4 + 12i minus 3 - 15i is which of the following?
questions.explanation: Subtract real parts: 4 - 3 = 1; subtract imaginary parts: 12i - (-15i) = 27i.

questions.question: The expression 5i - (-9 + i) simplifies to which of the following?
When subtracting complex numbers, the operation is performed by subtracting which components?
options: Real parts and adding imaginary parts
questions.explanation: Subtraction is done by subtracting real parts and subtracting imaginary parts separately.

questions.question: The sum of 2 + i and 3 - 2i is which of the following?
questions.explanation: Add real parts: 2 + 3 = 5; add imaginary parts: i - 2i = -i.

questions.question: The expression 45 - 22i minus 10 - 7i equals which of the following?
questions.explanation: Subtract real parts: 45 - 10 = 35; subtract imaginary parts: -22i - (-7i) = -15i.

questions.question: The expression 17 - (1 - i) simplifies to which of the following?
The expression i - (2 + 6i) simplifies to which of the following?
The expression 0 - (11 + 13i) simplifies to which of the following?
When multiplying complex numbers, i² is replaced by which value?
questions.explanation: The fundamental property is i² = -1.

questions.question: The product 7i(-5 + 2i) simplifies to which of the following?
questions.explanation: 7i(-5) = -35i and 7i(2i) = 14i² = -14, so the result is -14 - 35i.

questions.question: The product (1 - 5i)(-9 + 2i) equals which of the following?
questions.explanation: Expanding gives -9 + 2i + 45i - 10i² = 1 + 47i.

questions.question: The product (4 + i)(2 + 3i) simplifies to which of the following?
questions.explanation: Expanding gives 8 + 12i + 2i + 3i² = 5 + 14i.

questions.question: When a complex number is multiplied by its conjugate, the result is always which of the following?
questions.explanation: (a + bi)(a - bi) = a² + b², which is real.

questions.question: The product (1 - 8i)(1 + 8i) is which of the following?
questions.explanation: Expanding gives 1 - 64i² = 1 + 64 = 65.

questions.question: To write the quotient (3 - i)/(2 + 7i) in standard form, multiply numerator and denominator by which expression?
questions.explanation: Multiply by the conjugate of the denominator, which is 2 - 7i.

questions.question: The quotient 3/(9 - i) written in standard form is which of the following?
questions.explanation: Multiply by (9 + i)/(9 + i) to get (27 + 3i)/82.

questions.question: The quotient (6 - 9i)/(2i) simplifies to which of the following?
questions.explanation: Split the fraction and use 3/i = -3i to get -9/2 - 3i.

questions.question: The powers of i repeat every how many exponents?
questions.explanation: i¹ = i, i² = -1, i³ = -i, i⁴ = 1, and the pattern repeats every 4.

questions.question: The expression √(-36) equals which of the following?
When multiplying expressions containing square roots of negative numbers, the first step should be to convert them to which form?
questions.explanation: Convert square roots of negative numbers to complex numbers before multiplying to avoid errors.

questions.question: The product (2 - 7i)(3 + 4i) simplifies to which of the following?
questions.explanation: Expanding gives 6 + 8i - 21i - 28i² = 34 - 13i.

questions.question: The product -3(4 + 2i) simplifies to which of the following?
questions.explanation: Distribute -3 to get -12 - 6i.

questions.question: The expression 1/i simplifies to which of the following?
questions.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator by i to get i/i² = -i.

questions.question: The expression 3/(1 + i) simplifies to which of the following?
questions.explanation: Multiply by (1 - i)/(1 - i) to get (3 - 3i)/2.

questions.question: In polar coordinates, a point is represented by which ordered pair?
questions.explanation: Polar coordinates use (r, θ), where r is distance and θ is angle.

questions.question: The conversion from polar to rectangular coordinates uses which equations?
options: x = r sin θ, y = r cos θ
x = r tan θ, y = r cot θ
x = r cos θ, y = r tan θ
x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ
questions.explanation: The standard transformation is x = r cos θ and y = r sin θ.

questions.question: The point (2, π) in polar coordinates converts to which rectangular coordinates?
questions.explanation: x = 2 cos π = -2 and y = 2 sin π = 0.

questions.question: The point (5, π/2) in polar coordinates converts to which rectangular coordinates?
questions.explanation: x = 5 cos(π/2) = 0 and y = 5 sin(π/2) = 5.

questions.question: The rectangular coordinates (1, 1) convert to which polar coordinates?
questions.explanation: r = √(1² + 1²) = √2 and tan θ = 1, so θ = π/4.

questions.question: The point (0, 2) in rectangular coordinates converts to which polar coordinates?
questions.explanation: r = 2, and since x = 0 and y > 0, θ = π/2.
